```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
```

## Data Preparation

```{r data}
# Manually creating the dataset from the provided table
df <- data.frame(
  id = factor(1:18),
  Margarine = factor(c("B", "B", "B", "A", "B", "A", "B", "A", "B", "A", "B", "B", "A", "A", "A", "B", "A", "B")),
  Before = c(6.42, 6.76, 6.56, 4.8, 8.43, 7.49, 8.05, 5.05, 5.77, 3.91, 6.77, 6.44, 6.17, 7.67, 7.34, 6.85, 5.13, 5.73),
  After4weeks = c(5.83, 6.2, 5.83, 4.27, 7.71, 7.12, 7.25, 4.63, 5.31, 3.7, 6.15, 5.59, 5.56, 7.11, 6.84, 6.4, 4.52, 5.13),
  After8weeks = c(5.75, 6.13, 5.71, 4.15, 7.67, 7.05, 7.1, 4.67, 5.33, 3.66, 5.96, 5.64, 5.51, 6.96, 6.82, 6.29, 4.45, 5.17)
)

# Convert to long format for ANOVA
df_long <- df %>%
  gather(key = "Time", value = "Cholesterol", Before, After4weeks, After8weeks) %>%
  convert_as_factor(id, Time)

# Reorder Time levels so they appear chronologically in plots
df_long$Time <- factor(df_long$Time, levels = c("Before", "After4weeks", "After8weeks"))
```

## Mixed Model ANOVA

```{r anova}
# Two-way mixed ANOVA
res.aov <- anova_test(
  data = df_long, dv = Cholesterol, wid = id,
  between = Margarine, within = Time
)

get_anova_table(res.aov)
```

## Visualization

```{r plot}
bxp <- ggline(df_long, x = "Time", y = "Cholesterol", color = "Margarine",
       add = c("mean_se"),
       palette = "jco") +
  labs(title = "Cholesterol Change Over Time", subtitle = "Error bars: Mean +/- SE")

bxp
```
